purpose: Verified impact-mapping contract for legal and official-source changes affecting property rules, procedures, deadlines and published answers.
core_principle: CHANGE → EFFECTIVE DATE → TRANSITION → DEPENDENCY MAP → IMPACT → REVERIFICATION
dependency_rule: Only connected propositions, procedures, deadlines and answers are flagged unless a broader dependency is established.
historical_rule: Historical answers remain tied to the legal and evidential state applicable to their target date; later changes are not silently applied backward.
publication_rule: Materially affected current answers require reverification before continued VERIFIED_ANSWER status.
verification_boundary: This engine identifies potential impact and triggers review; it does not itself decide the substantive legal effect of a new law or judgment.
